          Cloud Applications Architect

          Noida
          Who We Are
          Insurity’s vision is all about empowerment. Empowering insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical software. It’s also about empowering our team members through tools, training, teamwork, and professional development opportunities.
          To talk the talk, we must walk the walk. We are the largest cloud-based insurance software provider for the Property & Casualty market. In 2021, we were trusted by 15 of the top 25 P&C carriers – now, in 2024, we are trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers. That’s proof we walk the walk. While our product suites are some of the most compelling in the industry, it’s our team members who deliver the exceptional value and unrivaled industry expertise our customers appreciate from us.
          Our team tells us over and over; working at Insurity offers you the opportunity to collaborate with and learn from some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance technology. You’ll feel welcomed even before you start your first day with us through our award-winning onboarding program.
          Take the first step to joining our team by applying today and we look forward to seeing #UatInsurity.
          What’s In It For U
          • Hybrid Workforce: Our hybrid workforce model supports building strong connections with your team members and a great culture.
          • Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it.
          • Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you.
          • More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent.
          • Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year.
          • Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 20% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average.
          • Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally.
          • Internal Networking: Build relationships, network, collaborate, and stay connected with colleagues internally with our one-of-a kind online Coffee for Two program.
          • Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses.
          • Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus.
          Insurity’s Cloud Applications Architect
          Join our innovative Cloud Operations Team as a Cloud Applications Architect and shape the future of scalable enterprise systems! In this pivotal role, you will architect, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud-based applications and infrastructure that power our critical business platforms. With a strong foundation in Java, Groovy scripting, and cloud-native technologies, you will play a key role in modernizing our application and automation stack, improving performance, and ensuring seamless integration across hybrid environments.
          You will collaborate closely with DevOps, infrastructure, and product teams to ensure high availability, reliability, and security across distributed systems. Your work will involve backend development, advanced troubleshooting, and infrastructure diagnostics — all while driving excellence in service delivery through Agile practices and a customer-first mindset.
          This role offers a unique opportunity to apply your deep technical skills to solve complex challenges, influence architectural decisions, and contribute to innovation in a fast-paced environment.

          What Our Cloud Applications Architect Will Do

          • Architect and manage cloud-hosted applications across Azure and AWS, ensuring high performance, scalability, and resilience.
          • Automation leadership, modernizing and consolidating our automation platforms
          • Integration services between our customers’ platforms and the Insurity Cloud such as authentication, file sharing, etc
          • Lead application operations integration, guiding product teams to design and deploy cloud-compliant solutions while establishing clear technology life cycles and ensuring alignment with Insurity Cloud best practices.
          • Mentor and provide technical leadership to team members across geographies, collaborating with architects in North America and driving productivity improvements for India-based teams.
          • Diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and application issues, utilizing tools like Dynatrace and Solarwinds, while serving as a technical escalation point for critical production problems.
          • Configure and manage Tomcat and Apache servers on various Linux distributions (RHEL, CentOS, Amazon Linux), and address system-level issues in collaboration with network and security teams.
          • Automate and enhance application functionality using Groovy and JavaScript and streamline operations through scripting and monitoring.
          • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, cloud operations, and security teams to strategize on future application hosting, performance optimization, and integration of new products into the Insurity Cloud.
          • Support Agile delivery practices, track work using Jira, and lead or participate in on-call rotations to maintain high service reliability and availability.
          • Continuously stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and cloud architecture best practices by engaging with professional publications, communities, and technical resources.

          Who We’re Looking For

          • 12+ years’ experience in managing enterprise-grade, 24x7 high-availability production environments
          • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (equivalent work experience may be considered)
          • Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience with:
            • Core and Advanced Java for backend development, debugging, and performance optimization
            • Groovy and JavaScript scripting for automation and business logic customization
            • Linux server administration across multiple distributions including RHEL 9.3/9.4, CentOS 7, and Amazon Linux (2 & 2023), deployed in Azure, AWS, and private cloud environments
            • Apache Tomcat configuration and management on Linux servers
            • Cloud platforms such as Azure (US/CA), AWS (CXP), and Insurity’s private cloud, with the ability to troubleshoot cloud-specific deployment and runtime issues
            • Relational databases (MS SQL, MySQL) with strong SQL querying, performance tuning, and data integrity focus
            • Networking and encryption fundamentals, including PGP/GPG encryption for secure data exchange
            • System and application monitoring tools like Dynatrace and SolarWinds for root cause analysis and proactive health checks
          • Agile development practices using Jira for sprint planning and task tracking
          • Strong customer-focused mindset, ensuring service responsiveness and high availability
          • Demonstrated ability to mentor team members, collaborate with North American architects and teams, and enhance team productivity in India
          • Willingness to travel up to 25% as per business needs
          Thank you for your interest in Insurity! Please understand that due to the volume of applicants we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.
